functions.name: fn_801BE0D4
functions.divergence: The recovered lookup, pitch adjustment, big-endian packet decode, scaled adjustment paths, state initialization, lookup-table clamp, dispatch, and flag update compile to the exact 640-byte retail text size. GC/1.2.5n selects a 104-byte frame and saves r25-r31 instead of retail's 88-byte frame and r26-r31 set; its endian-expression scheduling and conversion-temporary register allocation then diverge despite aligned control-flow landmarks.

functions.name: fn_801BE354
functions.divergence: The recovered per-channel base, target, signed delta, divisor, and state-flag operations align semantically. GC/1.2.5n emits 156 bytes rather than retail's 160 because it retains the channel base in a different saved register, combines address formation, and schedules the epilogue load before the restore sequence.
